Policy excerpts:
[atm-cash-not-dispensed] ATM didn't give me my cash (effective 2025-01-01)
If an ATM took money from your account but didn't give you the cash, or gave you less than you asked for, you can dispute it.

## What to do

1. Note the ATM location, date and time, and keep any receipt.
2. Check the app. Sometimes the ATM reverses the withdrawal on its own within a few days, and the transaction disappears or shows a matching credit.
3. If it's still there once the withdrawal has posted, open a dispute in the app within 60 days. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cash not

[atm-cash-not-dispensed] ATM didn't give me my cash (effective 2025-01-01)
within 60 days. Tap the transaction, then Get help, then Cash not dispensed.

## What happens next

We ask the ATM operator for its records. Most ATM cases are resolved within 10 business days. If the records show the cash wasn't dispensed, we credit the full amount, including any ATM fee we charged for that withdrawal.

## Pending withdrawals

You can't dispute a withdrawal while it's still pending. Wait until it posts.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[atm-network] Finding a BrookLink ATM (effective 2025-01-01)
on your plan, and the ATM owner may add a surcharge. The ATM screen should show the owner's surcharge before you confirm.

## Daily limits

ATM withdrawals count toward a daily ATM limit that depends on your plan. See "ATM withdrawal limits".

## Depositing cash

BrookLink ATMs don't take cash deposits. To add cash, use a participating retail store instead. See "Depositing cash at a store".

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[atm-limits] ATM withdrawal limits (effective 2025-01-01)
How much cash you can take out each day depends on your plan. The limit covers all ATMs combined, in the US and abroad.

| Plan | Daily ATM limit |
|---|---|
| Basic | $500 |
| Plus | $1,000 |
| Premium | $1,500 |

The daily limit resets at midnight Eastern Time.

## Can I raise my limit?

No. Limits are set by plan, and support can't raise them for a day or make exceptions. The only way to get a higher limit is to change plan.

## ATM limits versus the ATM's own

[atm-abroad] Using ATMs abroad (effective 2025-01-01)
up to the same monthly cap.

## Pick the local currency

If the ATM offers to convert the withdrawal into US dollars for you, decline and choose the local currency. The ATM's rate is usually worse than the network rate.

## Limits

Withdrawals abroad count toward the same daily ATM limit as withdrawals at home.

## If the ATM keeps your card

Freeze the card in the app straight away and report it lost. Premium members can ask for an emergency card abroad. Everyone else can use a virtual card in a mobile wallet until they're home.

Need more help? Message us in the

[cushion-premium] Cushion on Premium (effective 2025-01-01)
you past $200 below zero is declined.

## Limits

Cushion covers debit card purchases only. It never covers ATM withdrawals, transfers or wires.

## Repaying

Your next deposit repays it. If you stay negative for 30 days, Cushion is suspended. If the balance is still negative after 60 days, the account is restricted until it's repaid.

## Cost

Cushion has no fees and no interest ($0.00). It isn't a loan and isn't reported to credit bureaus.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is

request.instructions:
You are auditing the answer key of a customer-support benchmark for Tallowbrook, a fictional US neobank. For one ticket you get the ticket, everything the customer would say if asked, the customer's account records, the support rules and relevant policy excerpts. Decide which write actions support should take, if any.

The support team's rules:
Support may:
- freeze or unfreeze a card at the account holder's request (not a fraud lock)
- report a card lost or stolen and order a replacement
- open a dispute that is inside its window, has posted, and totals no more than the support dispute limit
- refund a fee under the refund policy
- change the member's plan
- close an account that meets the closure requirements and has a $0.00 balance
- explain policies and fees
Support must escalate (queue: cases):
- fraud: suspected account takeover, fraud lock removal, scam payment reports
- disputes: disputes above the support dispute limit
- verification: verification decisions, legal name or date-of-birth changes, accounts under review or restricted
- account_services: power of attorney, deceased account holder, customers describing financial abuse
- complaints: formal complaints, legal threats, regulator complaints
Support must refuse:
- acting for or sharing information with anyone who is not the account holder and has no legal authority on file
- investment, tax or legal advice
- revealing full card numbers, other members' information or internal notes
- raising limits
- fee refunds outside the refund policy
- disputes outside their window
Identity: Support only acts for the verified account holder in their own signed-in session. There are no joint accounts or authorized users.
Account takeover: Suspected account takeover goes to the Fraud team. Support freezes the member's cards and escalates.

Actions:
- change_plan(new_plan: basic|plus|premium, effective: immediate|next_billing_date)
- close_account()
- escalate_to_human(queue: fraud|disputes|verification|account_services|complaints, summary)
- freeze_card(card_id)
- open_dispute(txn_id, reason: unauthorized|merchant_not_received|merchant_not_as_described|duplicate|cancelled_recurring|atm_cash_not_dispensed)
- order_replacement_card(card_id, reason: lost|stolen|damaged, shipping: standard|expedited)
- refund_fee(txn_id, basis: error|goodwill|cooling_off)
- report_card_lost_stolen(card_id, reason: lost|stolen)
- unfreeze_card(card_id)

Today is 2026-09-15. Reply with one JSON object and nothing else:
{"actions": [{"action": "<action name>", "args": {...}}], "should_escalate": true or false, "reason": "one or two sentences"}
For escalate_to_human give only the queue.
